While summer sale pricing continues on AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off, AirPods Max 2 at $100 off, and Apple’s AirTag 2 down at $22 each, today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by this 24GB 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro at $320 off alongside the ongoing $500 price drop on the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro and the most affordable 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with the upgraded Power Adapter at $170 off. We also have official Apple USB-C cables from $7.50 a pop, a deep 32% price drop on Apple’s black iPhone 17 Pro Max TechWoven MagSafe case (Amazon all-time low), and more waiting below.

This 24GB 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro is $320 off today, 2TB M5 Pro now $500 off at Amazon

The best deal in MacBooks right now is hardly arguable – Amazon is offering the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro at a giant $500 off the new list price. For those interested in the M5 MacBook Air though, we have $200 off this 24GB configuration, and we also spotted a chance to save a sizable $320 off this more affordable pro option – the 24GB model M5 MacBook Pro.

B&H is currently offering the most affordable current-generation 24GB MacBook Pro you can buy – the model with 24GB of RAM and the 1TB storage capacity – down at $1,899 shipped.

This machine also ships with the upgraded official 96W Power Adapter that would normally run you an extra $20 had you configured this machine on the Apple site.

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $1,899 (Reg. $2,219)
  • With upgraded 96W Apple Power Adapter (worth $20 extra)

All of this leaves you with a regular price at $2,219 and $320 in savings for the best deal we can find on this machine from a reputable source. For the record, Amazon is charging $2,049 for this same model with the standard 70W charger.

Here’s a rundown of the best deals live on MacBook Pro this week:

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,849 (Reg. $1,999)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,299 (Reg. $2,499)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,499 (Reg. $2,999) – $500 off
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $2,699 (Reg. $3,099)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,299 (Reg. $3,599)
  • 16-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,999 (Reg. $4,399)

Land an M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB at $500 off, 48GB model at $400 off, more

Most affordable 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with upgraded Power Adapter is $170 off today

While we are still tracking a solid $200 off this 24GB M5 MacBook Pro, this morning we spotted a notable deal on the base 15-inch model you can score for $150 less than that – this one is now $170 off the list price.

Much like we detailed yesterday, Amazon is now offering $100 off just about every M5 MacBook Air configuration it sells:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,199 (Now Reg. $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,499 (Now Reg. $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,699 (Now Reg. $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,399 (Now Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,699 (Now Reg. $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,899 (Now Reg. $1,999)

However, B&H has some notable discounts this week, including the aforementioned 24GB model down at $1,499, and this 15-inch M5 MacBook Air base model package at $170 off:

B&H is now offering the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and the 512GB storage capacity down at $1,349 shipped.

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,349 (Reg. $1,519)
  • With upgraded 70W Apple Power Adapter (worth $20)

That’s already $150 off the list price and $50 better than Amazon, but B&H is also shipping this discounted model with the upgraded 70W Apple Power Adapter. Configuring this same machine with that charger straight at Apple will run you $1,519 – so you’re actually looking at $170 off here.

Extra 10% off already discounted official Apple USB-C, Thunderbolt, and MagSafe cables today, deals from $7.50 each

Apple’s black iPhone 17 Pro Max TechWoven MagSafe case is 32% off (Amazon all-time low)

Latest AirTag 2 still at all-time low Black Friday in July pricing, now $22 each

Much like the AirPods deals we featured this morning – AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off, AirPods Max 2 $100 off, and AirPods 4 from $99, today looks to be the last chance to land all-time low pricing on Apple’s latest AirTag 2 item trackers.

Amazon bought back its all-time low pricing on the latest 2026 Apple AirTag 4-pack for Black Friday in July week, and with many of those official sale events scheduled to end this evening, today might be your last shot to score it – Amazon now has a countdown clock on this deal suggesting it will be gone come midnight.

  • AirTag 2 $27 (Reg. $29)
  • AirTag 2 (4-pack) $89 (Reg. $99)

Latest Nitro Black Beats 240W braided USB-C cable drops to $18 at Amazon (40% off)

Apple Watch Series 11 summer deals starting to disappear, get in there while most popular models are still $100 off

While we are still tracking summer sale pricing on AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off, AirPods Max 2 at $100 off, and all-time low pricing on the 4-pack of Apple’s AirTag 2, but the deals on the most affordable Apple Watch Series 11 are starting to disappear. You’ll want to get in there as soon as possible if you’re interested in upgrading your Apple wearable at $100 off.

Amazon is currently offering the 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 down at $299 and the 46mm model at $329 shipped. That’s $100 off the respective $399 and $429 regular list prices on the most affordable models you can buy.

However, color options on these deals are starting to disappear now. There are still a few colors live at the discounted rates, but it appears these summertime discounts on the Series 11 are starting to either go out of stock or jump back up as of this week.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (Reg. $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (Reg. $429)

As mentioned above, these $100 price drops are joined by some notable ongoing discounts on the latest AirPods, iPhone 17 Pro, and some particularly deep $500 discounts on the M5 Pro MacBook Pro lineup:

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (Reg. $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC $145 (Reg. $179)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC $119 (Reg. $179 new) – Renewed Premium

Amazon’s best quality renewed iPhone 17 Pro units are $220 off, 17 Pro Max up to $450 off

If you’re liking to secure yourself a current-generation iPhone 17 Pro or Pro Max at a discount, there are some options floating around this week. Deals on brand new unlocked condition units are tough to come by from reputable sources, but we are still tracking up to $220 off 17 Pro in Amazon’s best quality renewed condition, and Woot is once again highlighting the up to $450 off 17 Pro Max right now.

Over at Amazon you’ll find the 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models live again at up to $220 off – these are Amazon Renewed Premium units with a 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and “greater than 90% original battery life.” Standard Amazon refurbished units only come with a 90-day warranty and you don’t get the same battery guarantee either.

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,199 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,199 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,199 (Reg. $1,299 new)

Over at Woot, however, the larger 17 Pro Max deals are still flying on “pristine” condition units that “have never been in customer hands.” You’re looking at up to $450 off the list prices from Apple here but color options are starting to dwindle:

  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 512GB $1,300 (Reg. $1,399)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 1TB $1,450 (Reg. $1,599)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 2TB $1,550 (Reg. $1,999)
